stepTitle: During an ice skating performance, an initially motionless $$80.0\, \text{kg}$$ clown throws a fake barbell away. The clown’s ice skates allow her to recoil frictionlessly. If the clown recoils with a velocity of $$0.500\,\text{m/s}$$ and the barbell is thrown with a velocity of $$10.0\,\text{m/s},$$ what is the mass of the barbell (in $$\text{kg})$$?
